selection: One symmetric, uniform dead-traction loading of outer top and bottom material layers; no axial displacement constraint, lateral DOFs free. No further fixture variant allowed this turn.
physical_rationale: Apply distributed normal force on the physical outer faces, avoiding the rigid common axial displacement and its known end-corner constraint. This is a candidate improvement, not an assumed remedy.
precheck_type: One non-damaging independent elastic equilibrium solve, no topology changes or native fracture
initial_coordinates: Exact pristine reference after explicit A0 pre-cuts, zero initial displacement and velocity
rigid_motion_handling: Balanced forces, exact symmetric starting state; no local artificial physical pins. Center translation removed only as a gauge in reporting, not internal deformation.
energy_implementation: Existing validated analysis/dual_track_v1/energy_y.so, force-compatible expanded LPS with fixed full-family m
regions: Exactly prior fixed horizon-wide reference regions; notch front prioritized, then notch mouth, grip, other finite-X surface, interior
stop: Do not launch a formal fracture if this one precheck is unaccepted, front is not the leading tensile-stretch region, contact is unresolved, or physical budget cannot be supported. Do not rerun another loading variant.

formal_candidate_if_admitted.ramp: half-cosine symmetric traction, amplitude must be frozen from the accepted elastic precheck before any formal run
